scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/copy-runtime-public-assets.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/index.html';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');s=s.replace(/ crossorigin(=\"[^\"]*\")?/g,'');fs.writeFileSync(p,s);console.log('stripped crossorigin')"
scripts.release:check: npm run verify:redbull-wheels && npm run build && npm run metadata
scripts.zip: npm run release:check && cd dist && zip -FS -r ../submission.zip . && cd .. && node scripts/capture-release-metadata.mjs --include-zip
scripts.package:offline8m: node scripts/prepare-offline8m-assets.mjs && node scripts/diagnose-offline-start.mjs && VITE_F1TI_OFFLINE_8M=1 vite build --outDir dist-offline8m && node scripts/package-offline8m.mjs && node scripts/h5-validator.mjs f1ti-offline-8mb.zip
scripts.package:lite-fom-mobile: node scripts/prepare-compact30-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-offline8m-assets.mjs && VITE_F1TI_OFFLINE_8M=1 VITE_F1TI_FULL_UPLOAD=1 vite build --outDir dist-current-offline-upload && F1TI_UPLOAD_ARCHIVE=f1ti-lite-fom-mobile-new.zip F1TI_UPLOAD_CAR=.compact30-assets/fom-player-no-draco.glb F1TI_UPLOAD_APP=index-f1ti-lite-current.js node scripts/package-current-offline-upload.mjs && F1TI_ALLOW_OVERSIZE=1 node scripts/h5-validator.mjs f1ti-lite-fom-mobile-new.zip
scripts.package:lite-fom-mobile-v5: node scripts/prepare-compact30-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-offline8m-assets.mjs && VITE_F1TI_OFFLINE_8M=1 VITE_F1TI_FULL_UPLOAD=1 VITE_F1TI_DIAGNOSTIC_EMBED_CAR=1 vite build --outDir dist-current-offline-upload && F1TI_UPLOAD_ARCHIVE=f1ti-lite-fom-mobile-v5-textured.zip F1TI_UPLOAD_CAR=.compact30-assets/fom-player-no-draco.glb F1TI_UPLOAD_APP=index-f1ti-lite-v5.js F1TI_UPLOAD_EMBEDDED_CAR=1 node scripts/package-current-offline-upload.mjs && F1TI_ALLOW_OVERSIZE=1 node scripts/h5-validator.mjs f1ti-lite-fom-mobile-v5-textured.zip
scripts.build:compact30: node scripts/prepare-compact30-assets.mjs && VITE_F1TI_COMPACT30=1 vite build --outDir dist-compact30 && node scripts/copy-compact30-runtime.mjs
scripts.build:embedded-texture-test: node scripts/prepare-compact30-assets.mjs && VITE_F1TI_COMPACT30=1 VITE_F1TI_USE_EMBEDDED_TRACK_TEXTURES=1 vite build --outDir dist-embedded-texture-test && F1TI_COMPACT_OUT_DIR=dist-embedded-texture-test F1TI_SKIP_TRACK_OVERRIDES=1 node scripts/copy-compact30-runtime.mjs
scripts.build:compressed-texture-test: node scripts/prepare-compact30-assets.mjs && VITE_F1TI_COMPACT30=1 VITE_F1TI_COMPRESSED_TRACK_TEXTURES=1 vite build --outDir dist-compressed-texture-test && F1TI_COMPACT_OUT_DIR=dist-compressed-texture-test F1TI_COMPRESSED_TRACK_TEXTURES=1 node scripts/copy-compact30-runtime.mjs
scripts.build:lite-fom-test: node scripts/prepare-compact30-assets.mjs && VITE_F1TI_COMPACT30=1 VITE_F1TI_COMPRESSED_TRACK_TEXTURES=1 VITE_F1TI_LITE_SINGLE_CAR=1 vite build --outDir dist-lite-fom-test && F1TI_COMPACT_OUT_DIR=dist-lite-fom-test F1TI_COMPRESSED_TRACK_TEXTURES=1 node scripts/copy-compact30-runtime.mjs
